About

Raised on music.
Built in the studio.

Kroon was born in the Netherlands and grew up surrounded by music, picking up instruments at an early age. Music runs in the family: his grandfather played in a renowned jazz band, and Kroon was brought along to shows from a young age, watching live music work a room long before he understood why.

At twelve he discovered music production and never stopped. Over ten years in the studio and four years behind the decks later, that foundation shows in every set: strong, carefully built tracks delivered with a high energy presence that pulls the floor in.

Kroon reads the room and shapes each set to the night, letting the crowd steer where the sound goes. After playing shows across the Netherlands, he moved to Barcelona to take his music career further.
